'''Tanek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Chapter 3" /> [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Human" /> from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zakuul]]<ref name="Homeworld" /> who served in the [[Knights of Zakuul]], an order of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] warriors who protected the [[Eternal Empire]] and its ruler, the Immortal Emperor.<ref name="Chapter 3" />

==Biography==
In [[3631 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> he was partnered with a fellow Knight named [[Novo]], and they were among the Zakuulan forces that attempted to stop the [[Rescue of the Outlander|escape]] of the criminal known as [[Alliance Commander|the Outlander]] from the [[Spire (Zakuul)|Spire]] on Zakuul. Tanek met his end as a result of the encounter. Novo later blamed the Outlander for Tanek's death, even though it was not the Outlander who struck the killing blow.<ref name="Chapter 3" /> Years later in [[3626 BBY]], Tanek was among the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirits]] that were summoned to help the [[Outlander]] to [[Mission to Kira Carsen's ship|defeat]] [[Tenebrae]]. Once Tenebrae was defeated, he became [[The Force/Legends|one with the Force]], finding peace.<ref name="Echoes">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=General|Echoes of Oblivion|[[Kira Carsen's ship]]}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Players have two options: let Tanek be killed by Lana Beniko for dark side points and influence with Beniko, or set him free for light side points and lose influence with Beniko. If he is spared, Tanek will be executed by [[Vaylin]] for letting the Outlander escape.<ref name="Chapter 3" />
